### For the Love of Slavery
Author: John Sartelle
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/love-of-slavery
Passage: Galatians 2:4
Points:
- Attempting to earn salvation through the law or human performance leads back into spiritual bondage.
- Believers frequently face the subtle temptation to take credit for their holiness and rely on self-sufficiency.
- True freedom comes exclusively through resting in Christ alone rather than personal striving.
- Paul defended the sufficiency of grace in Jerusalem by refusing to compel Titus into circumcision.
- In Christ, believers are freed from the condemning lie that their obedience is never enough.

### Day 302: Galatians 2:1–10
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-302-galatians-2-110.html
Passage: Galatians 2:9
Points:
- Early church leaders had contrasting backgrounds and personalities designed to fit together rather than be identical.
- Extending the right hand of fellowship requires recognizing the work of God's grace in others.
- Christian unity does not demand conformity in every theological detail or ministry style.
- Seasoned leaders should support and encourage emerging believers rather than trying to clone themselves.
- God prepares each person according to His timing for a distinct calling in His kingdom.
